enriched_activities.activity: Sleeping, using fan to stay cool during heatwave
enriched_activities.desc: Adjust fan speed. Turn body to left side. Pull sheet over shoulder. Turn fan direction. Turn body to right side. Push sheet off. Turn fan speed higher. Adjust pillow. Turn body to back. Stretch arms. Turn fan speed lower. Pull sheet up. Turn body to left side. Adjust fan direction. Turn body to right side. Kick sheet off. Turn fan off. Turn fan on. Adjust fan speed.
Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry body with towel. Exit bathroom.

Enter kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out milk and cereal. Close refrigerator. Take out bowl and spoon from cabinet. Pour cereal into bowl. Pour milk into bowl. Sit at table. Eat cereal. Drink milk. Rinse bowl in sink. Place bowl in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for work
enriched_activities.desc: Enter bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt and pants. Close closet. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Pick up phone and bag. Walk out of bedroom.

Walk to bus stop. Stand at bus stop. Check phone. Board bus. Insert card into fare box. Walk to seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Get up. Walk to exit. Step off bus. Walk to office building. Push door open. Walk to elevator. Press elevator button. Enter elevator. Press floor button. Exit elevator. Walk to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as community program coordinator at nonprofit
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at desk. Turn on computer. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Attend staff meeting. Take notes. Talk to supervisor. Make phone calls to partners. Organize event materials. Update database. Write report. Print report. Eat lunch. Attend webinar. Answer phone calls. Send emails. Shut down computer. Pack bag. Leave office.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Listen to music. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter building. Walk to apartment. Unlock door. Enter home. Take off shoes.

Enter kitchen. Wash hands. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and chicken. Close refrigerator. Chop vegetables. Season chicken. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Put chicken in pan. Stir chicken. Add vegetables. Stir. Turn off stove. Serve food onto plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Rinse plate in sink. Place plate in dishwasher.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing, watching TV and using computer, cooling off with air conditioner
enriched_activities.desc: Enter living room. Turn on air conditioner. Turn on TV. Sit on sofa. Watch TV. Pick up laptop. Open laptop. Check email. Scroll through social media. Watch a video. Close laptop. Pick up phone. Check messages. Play a game. Put down phone. Stand up. Stretch. Watch movie. Turn off TV. Turn off air conditioner.

Enter bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off tap. Apply facial cleanser. Rub face. Rinse face. Turn on shower. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Rub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Dry body with towel.
Enter bedroom. Turn on fan. Adjust fan speed. Lie down on bed. Pull sheet up. Close eyes. Turn body to side. Adjust pillow. Lie still.
